senses.definition: n.pr.m. (abundance, superabundance)—a son of Heman, according to 1 Ch 25:4, 28 (but on the ostensible list of names v. Ew§ 274 b WeProl.229; Hist. Isr. 219 RSOTJC 224; 2nd ed. 143).
